what_it_holds_for_the_confocal_laser: Readings at 100% level with mirror in, multiband out, IR in: 488 nm 6.9 mW at 20x, 7.0 at 4x, 7.0 at 10x; a second block 6.5 / 6.9 / 6.7; a third 9.9 / 10.6 / 10.3 (20x / 4x / 10x). Level sweeps at 20x only, partly blank or '-'. Not measured: 405 nm, and 100x for any line. Read by this seat from the file; values not yet entered.
blank_in_the_worksheet: head type, head wavelength setting, head aperture, head position, which Micro-Manager configuration was loaded, room light, the 100x decision; the Checks sheet's spot-fits-sensor column; the second and third confocal blocks' wavelengths.

spot_fits_sensor.answer: all the spots are inside the sensor
spot_fits_sensor.asked: did the laser spot fit inside the power meter's sensor at 4x, 10x and 20x
spot_fits_sensor.consequence: the readings are power at the sample, not lower bounds. Taken to cover the third confocal block too, despite its note 'apperture full, size is different', because the answer was 'all'.

meter_head_and_wavelength_setting.answer: we changed the wavelength properly for each measurement
meter_head_and_wavelength_setting.asked: which meter head was used, and was its wavelength setting changed for each laser line
meter_head_and_wavelength_setting.consequence: each reading was taken with the head set to that line's wavelength, so no responsivity correction is owed. The head TYPE was not stated; a wavelength setting implies a photodiode head, which is an inference and is recorded as one.

validity_period.asked: how long should these readings be trusted before re-measuring
validity_period.consequence: anchored to 2026-09-24, the day the person said it, as the person worded it -- not to the 2026-09-09 measurement date. A change to the laser, fibre or light path is not named as an earlier end, and would still falsify the readings physically; that is for the entries' falsifier, not a second period.

unlabelled_confocal_blocks_are_561_and_6.asked: are the two unlabelled confocal blocks the 561 nm and 640 nm lines
unlabelled_confocal_blocks_are_561_and_6.consequence: Power sheet rows 83-90 are the 561 nm line and rows 119-126 the 640 nm line; rows 46-53 are 488 nm as labelled.

meter_and_head.answer: we used thorlab MD100 with sensor head S120C or S121C
meter_and_head.consequence: a photodiode head, as inferred from the per-line wavelength setting -- now stated rather than inferred. WHICH of the two heads is not known; the person said 'or'.
meter_and_head.discrepancy: the worksheet's Meta sheet says 'PM100A, throlab' and the person said 'MD100'. Thorlabs sells PM100A and PM100D consoles; 'MD100' matches neither exactly. Put back to the person; both are recorded as said. The console does not change a reading taken with the right head and wavelength setting, so this does not hold the entries.

discrepancy_resolved.consequence: the console was a Thorlabs PM100A, as the worksheet's Meta sheet says; 'MD100' was a slip.
